Type: medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a sofa area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: polypropylene, low pile
Colors: grey, orange, navy, pink and multicolor accents
Shape: large rectangle, central floral medallion, corner motifs, ornate orange border, low pile
Feel: vibrant, warm, eclectic
Goes with: cognac leather, dark wood floors, white walls; eclectic or transitional rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Polypropylene Rug, 6'7" x 9'6", Gray, Orange, Multicolor
product.description: Brighten your room with the tasteful colors and captivating design of this elegant rug. Grays, oranges, and golds combine to form a detailed pattern that perfectly enhances traditional-style home decor. With a medium-height pile, this rug is ideal for moderately trafficked areas. 6'7" x 9'6" Imported; 100% polypropylene pile with 100% jute backing Advanced power-loom construction for excellent value and quality Medium .5'' pile is ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
